summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Beward MQTT/HTTP driver refactor. Backend pytest: 16/16 green in /app/backend/tests/test_beward_mqtt.py plus 8/8 in the pre-existing test_beward.py (unit mappings). Covered: GET/PUT/test/log of /api/integrations/mqtt (admin only, host 156.67.82.199:1883 preserved, probe returns ok=True 'Conectado', bus.status.connected=True); agent-token lifecycle (POST /api/agents returns nxa_... token once, GET /api/agents hides token_hash, generating a new one revokes the previous, POST /api/agents/{id}/revoke); agent API with Bearer token (GET /api/agent/config lists only beward_http controllers of the agent's site with decrypted password; invalid token -> 401; POST /api/agent/events/heartbeat and /api/agent/events/verify return {code:200,desc:OK}; GET /api/agent/commands long-poll); PUT /api/structure/sites/{id}/business-hours persists hours. Unit-level: beward_ingest.on_mqtt('mqtt/face/heartbeat',...) marks controller online with last_heartbeat and device_ip; on_mqtt(RecPush) creates an access_event with captured_photo (data: prefix added), direction_mismatch=True on TEST999 (device dir=saida vs point entrada), raises exactly 1 'sentido_divergente' alarm (priority baixa) on first occurrence only, updates controller.last_event_at and controller.direction_mismatch; a repeat RecPush with the same RecordID is deduped (still 1 event). watch_once in business hours (00:00-23:59 all days, threshold 1 min, last_event_at 5h old, online) raises exactly 1 'sem_eventos' alarm (priority baixa) and sets no_event_alerted=True (second call does NOT repeat); outside business hours (00:00-00:01 window) raises 0. BewardMqttDriver.sync_person on offline controller returns {queued:True} and inserts an mqtt_commands doc with status='queued'. Frontend (/configuracoes/integracoes): all MQTT testids present (mqtt-host '156.67.82.199', mqtt-port '1883', mqtt-username, mqtt-password, mqtt-enabled, mqtt-client-id, mqtt-test-button, mqtt-save-button, mqtt-log). Clicking Testar shows mqtt-test-result='Conectado (224 ms)' and mqtt-connected='Conectado'. Frontend (/controladoras): ControllerDialog on 'Nova' with Beward facial exposes controller-transport, controller-beward-id, controller-decision-mode, no-event-alert-fields with controller-no-event-minutes/site-hours-start/site-hours-end/site-day-{1..7}, beward-setup-panel. In HTTP mode the setup panel contains 'desmarcar Habilitar' and 'porta 5011'; agent-token-panel renders (admin + site selected). Switching Protocolo to MQTT updates panel text to mention 'Não inscrever' and 'heartbeat', AND hides agent-token-panel (as required). Existing real controller 'Facial Porta Pilares' card renders beward-health-{id} with Modo='HTTP local (agente) · ID 1457460', Último heartbeat and Último evento rows. All 8 review bullets PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/beward_ingest.py::on_mqtt publishes PushAck BEFORE awaiting record() — correct per spec (Ack every RecPush/StrSnapPush). On MQTT path, wants_online is additionally gated by VerifyStatus==22 (face match) which means only matched identifications trigger the online decision; non-match status codes fall to the offline-style event write — this matches the behavior tested and the spec but is worth documenting next to the condition.

backend/mqtt_bus.py::command stores the command doc with status='sent' only if (connected and online); otherwise it stores status='queued' and returns {ok:False, queued:True}. flush_queue re-publishes queued commands on next heartbeat. Verified by TestMqttDriverQueue.

backend/routers/integrations.py::agent_auth updates last_used_at/last_ip on every authenticated call — good audit trail. agent_commands long-poll is bounded by max(1,min(wait,25))*2 iterations of 0.5s = up to 50s, which exceeds the typical 25s LB idle timeout; consider capping to <=20s to avoid 504s under Kubernetes ingress.

backend/drivers/beward.py::BewardHttpDriver._post now delegates to routers.integrations.run_via_agent — this correctly turns every HTTP action into an agent_commands entry awaited for up to 15s. The direct variant is preserved as _post_direct (unused) in case of local testing; consider removing or marking private to avoid confusion.

frontend/src/components/equipment/BewardPanels.jsx::AgentTokenPanel calls window.confirm — fine for admin ops, but inside a shadcn Dialog it is still OK; the panel is correctly hidden when transport!=='http' (verified).
frontend/src/pages/Integrations.jsx polls /integrations/mqtt/log every 5s unconditionally; consider pausing when tab is hidden (document.visibilityState) to reduce API load.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (new — loads backend/.env so motor can import database)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_MQTT (beward_device_id=TEST999) and TEST_HTTP controllers + their access_points, plus 2 TEST_ agent tokens on the real site, during tests. After the pytest run some records remained due to xdist parallelism (per-worker module-scope cleanup); a manual sweep removed all remaining TEST_ controllers (9), access_points (6), alarms (1), events (1), mqtt_commands (0), beward_dedup (0). All agent tokens are revoked (0 active). The real controller 'Facial Porta Pilares' (beward_device_id 1457460) was NOT touched; no commands were sent to device 1457460.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_beward_mqtt.py uses a module-level event loop (_MODULE_LOOP + _run helper) because motor binds to the first loop and xdist/pytest tries to spin new loops per asyncio.run — do NOT replace with asyncio.run or pytest-asyncio without preserving the shared loop. conftest.py loads /app/backend/.env so direct imports of database/security work when running pytest from /app/backend. Note: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, so the module-autouse cleanup fixture only cleans data created in that worker; if you re-run, do a manual TEST_ sweep like the one in this report. Testids added by this iteration: mqtt-host, mqtt-port, mqtt-username, mqtt-password, mqtt-client-id, mqtt-enabled, mqtt-save-button, mqtt-test-button, mqtt-test-result, mqtt-connected, mqtt-msg-count, mqtt-log, mqtt-status, integrations-page, controller-transport, controller-beward-id, controller-decision-mode, controller-no-event-minutes, site-hours-start, site-hours-end, site-day-{1..7}, beward-setup-panel, agent-token-panel, agent-token-value, agent-token-info, agent-token-generate, agent-token-revoke, beward-health-{id}, beward-no-event-{id}, beward-direction-{id}, no-event-alert-fields.
